_comment: E2E shot plan template (framework v2). Games AUTHOR their own copy at <game>/e2e_shots.json. run-e2e-review.sh selects groups by PR diff (group.match regexes), resolves them into a flat plan, and runs e2e_capture.gd. Example below is mini-pong (game loop archetype). Shot-level "deadline_s" (seconds) overrides max_wall_seconds for that shot only; absent → falls back to the global max_wall_seconds (backward compatible, #372). #586 (e2e_script script-adjudication groups): shots may carry an optional text contract — "scene_description" (what the frame shows), "trigger" (how the rig reaches it), "composition" (intended camera/arrangement) — passed through to results.json as metadata; see the 01_title example comment below.

loop._comment: Default archetype: one full game loop storyboard. Active unless a more specific group matches.

shots.name: 01_title
shots._comment: Text-contract fields (optional, #586 e2e_script style): "scene_description" = what the frame shows, "trigger" = how the rig/driver reaches this state, "composition" = intended camera/arrangement. Pure-JSON template: document them in the shot as _comment or as real fields — e.g. { "scene_description": "雪夜村口开场…", "trigger": "rig 驱动 BattleAssembler 出生态…", "composition": "中景对称构图…" }. e2e_capture.gd passes them through to results.json as metadata when present.

visual_pause._comment: PR touching pause overlay: inject Escape, capture PAUSED, unpause.

content._comment: Content archetype (narrative games): journey/walkthrough. Placeholder — populated per game at C5.5 assembly.

journey._comment: Journey archetype (narrative games): full playthrough + transcript + state trajectory. Populated per game.
